value.history: Bài và phiên bản trước (6)Capital Chronicle on gas: slower refill does not establish a shortage · KEEPCC REPORT / EVENT UNCONFIRMED — Capital Chronicle reports a dated tension: less gas added than the same-week seasonal average, yet more gas already stored than the five-year stock average. If confirmed, that combination calls for separating the available buffer from the pace at which it is being replenished. It does not by itself establish a shortage or a price direction.
